task_groups.title: Implement resolveUserID and resolveOrgID resolver functions

subtasks.title: Create internal/handlers/resolve.go with resolveUserID
details: Create internal/handlers/resolve.go in package handlers
Implement resolveUserID(db Executor, selector string) (string, error)
Step 1: if uuid.Parse(selector) succeeds, execute SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = ? and return result or sql.ErrNoRows
Step 2: if strings.Contains(selector, '@'), execute SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ? and return result or sql.ErrNoRows
Step 3 (fallback): execute SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ? and return result or sql.ErrNoRows
Import google/uuid and database/sql packages

subtasks.title: Implement resolveOrgID in internal/handlers/resolve.go
details: In the same resolve.go file, implement resolveOrgID(db Executor, selector string) (string, error)
Step 1: if uuid.Parse(selector) succeeds, execute SELECT id FROM orgs WHERE id = ? and return result or sql.ErrNoRows
Step 2 (fallback, no email heuristic): execute SELECT id FROM orgs WHERE slug = ? and return result or sql.ErrNoRows
Note: org resolver does NOT apply the '@' email heuristic — any non-UUID string falls through to slug lookup
